description:
Every Moon mission begins with one decision: where and when to land. We are a passionate team committed to space exploration and well-crafted technology. Our project, LunaLens, turns lunar terrain and Sun and Earth position data into a clear tool for mission planners. We bring together web development, Python, data analysis, 3D visualization, and interface design. With our team in place, we are focused on delivering a prototype that mission planners can trust.

See you on the moon🚀
